title: Synthesis --- The Gift and the Motive
label: ch:synthesis-por-para
canDo: I can change the meaning of a sentence by choosing between por and para.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C51-sintesis-regalo-motivo: say the dinner sentence both ways and say what a wrong choice actually produces.
payoff.note: First place where the smallest word carries the sentence's emotional content. A wrong choice is not bad grammar -- it is a true sentence about a different situation.
